prompt:
Create ONE square image 1254x1254: a 2x2 sheet of four game skill icons for a medieval dark-fantasy turn-based RPG hero called the Redtithe, a blood hunter (see the attached character reference: dark-haired woman in dark brown leather vest, red sash, bandaged forearms marked with a red branching vein rune, a curved sickle-shaped dagger, blood vials on her belt, a small brass tithe bowl on a chain). Theme: blood, a tenth taken as tithe, a mark, veins. Style: painted digital fantasy game icon, crisp clean edges, soft rim light, rich but limited palette: deep crimson and dark blood red, worn brown leather, tarnished steel, pale old gold / brass. ABSOLUTELY NO PURPLE, no violet, no magenta, no blue magic. Background: fully transparent (real alpha) around every icon; NO checkerboard pattern painted in, no background scenery, no square tiles. The four icons sit in a 2x2 grid, each centred in its own quarter with a wide empty margin; nothing touches a quarter edge and nothing spills into a neighbour quarter. Rules for every icon: ONE clear central subject, strong readable silhouette at small size (48 px), few shapes, very few droplets or sparks, no grain, no noise, no speckles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no UI, no modern objects. The four silhouettes must be clearly different from each other.
These four are EVOLVED versions of the attached base icon sheet (same positions): each must clearly share the main object of its base icon but show the evolution and be visibly different and more powerful.
TOP-LEFT 'Blood Tithe's Fury' (evolved Blood Tithe: quickened further, and a magic hit on her fuels her next strike): the same brass tithe bowl on its chain, now brimming over and boiling, blood surging upward out of it in three tongues shaped like rising flames of blood, bright crimson inner glow.

BOTTOM-LEFT 'Reaping Brand' (evolved Blood Brand: when the mark ends the bearer takes damage and the brand resets): the same branching crimson vein rune, floating on its own, enclosed by a large curved sickle blade sweeping around it in a crescent, as if reaping the rune; a single circular trail of blood follows the sickle.
BOTTOM-RIGHT 'Mirror Ward' (evolved Mirror Vein: spells it absorbs are thrown back at the caster): the same glossy liquid-blood heater shield with pale-gold rim, a pale white-gold spell bolt hitting its face and bouncing straight back out in a sharp V ricochet; the shield face rippling outward.
